messages:
incident-bot: PROD ALERT: spike in 502s from axiom-proxy (prod-eu-west). Error rate ~17% over last 5m, p95 latency increased. Investigate. :rotating_light:
oncall-miguel: paging oncall (miguel) — I'm awake, looking now
oncall-miguel: seeing 502s on /v1/infer and /v1/chat endpoints, lots of upstream reset logs in axiom-proxy
sre-leah: I'm on logs and obs, pushing a short query to aggregate by upstream host
sre-leah: top upstream: model-fanout-3 (10.42.8.33) showing TCP RSTs, connection errors spike at 02:31:50
eng-runtime-raj: any ongoing deploys? check deploy-bot
pagerduty-bot: Deploy pipeline: no active prod deploys in the last 6 hours
support-tony: CS ticket flood: several customers report requests failing with 502s, marking high priority
platform-anya: can we throttle large clients temporarily? we have a few very noisy API keys in last 10m
oncall-miguel: running quick curl to proxied endpoint to reproduce: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
=> returns 502 consistently from eu-west
sre-leah: tail of axiom-proxy logs (filtered): 
```
2026-03-17T02:31:48Z axiom-proxy[proxy-1] upstream error: connection reset by peer to 10.42.8.33:443
2026-03-17T02:31:49Z axiom-proxy[proxy-2] upstream error: timeout waiting for headers from 10.42.8.34
```
eng-runtime-raj: looks like upstream pool saturation + occasional pod restarts on model-fanout-3 nodes
eng-runtime-raj: I'm going to temporarily reduce fanout concurrency for model-fanout-3 via runtime config (runtime.fanout.max_concurrency=8)
oncall-miguel: +1 do that, also enable fallback to model-fanout-2 for new requests (route rewrite)
platform-anya: I'll prepare traffic-shift to route 30% of eu-west traffic to prod-us-east fallback pool — low-risk and quick
support-tony: notifying affected customers with ETA ~20m mitigation window :email: 
sre-leah: executed k8s check: model-fanout-3 pods are flapping (OOMKilled x2) and CPU at 98% on two nodes
eng-runtime-raj: scaling deployment model-fanout-3 from 6 -> 10 replicas, and adding nodepool autoscale request. Applying now:
```
kubectl scale deploy/model-fanout-3 --replicas=10 -n prod
```
oncall-miguel: applied fanout throttling config and put route fallback in place, watching metrics
eng-runtime-raj: also lowering keepalive and upstream idle connection reuse temporarily to avoid head-of-line issues (proxy keepalive=0)
platform-anya: traffic shift to us-east started: 30% success, error rate overall dropping from 17% -> 8% in 5m
sre-leah: customer impact: ~4% of total traffic still seeing intermittent 502s (those pinned to eu-west noisy clients)
support-tony: updated CS with mitigation steps and interim workaround (retry with backoff)
oncall-miguel: can we block the top 3 noisy API keys while we stabilize?
eng-runtime-raj: running script to mute keys temporarily (rate limit to 10 rps):
```
POST /admin/keys/bulk-rate-limit {"keys": ["k_abc123","k_def456","k_ghi789"], "limit":10}
```
eng-runtime-raj: keys throttled, large client pressure easing
sre-leah: metrics now: error rate 2.3% over 1m, p95 latency back to normal ranges
oncall-miguel: great. I'll stay on incident for 30m to watch for recurrence. setting monitoring alert to elevated but stable
platform-anya: rolling node pool replacement on the two flapping nodes to remove noisy kernel state, cordon/drain in progress
support-tony: added customer note to status page: "Partial degradation in eu-west; mitigations in place; full recovery expected in 20-40 minutes."
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation deployed (traffic-shift, throttles, scaling). Error-rate trending down. Owners: eng-runtime-raj, oncall-miguel, platform-anya.
sre-leah: quick action items: postmortem owner: eng-runtime-raj to drill into OOM patterns, platform to review node autoscaling thresholds, product to consider API-key usage doc for best practices
oncall-miguel: handing off active watch to night oncall at 03:00 UTC — leaving notes in pagerduty. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Handoff created: incident #INC-20260317-921, next-oncall @oncall-sam assigned
support-tony: leaving customer comms handover to morning CS shift with log of affected keys and timing
eng-runtime-raj: will create an evaluation run to check if recent model memory growth correlates with our quantization change last week
platform-anya: follow-up tasks created in #incidents-postmortems board
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Error-rate returned to baseline at 02:44:47 UTC. Monitoring for 30m. Postmortem pending. :white_check_mark:
